rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: Under '05.10.2000' the party journal reports that Central Election Authority chairman Ram Niwas Mirdha rescheduled the election programme, including the election of the party president, by ten days: the election of the party president 'alongwith the PCC Chiefs, AICC executive members and PEC members' would be held on November 11 and, if contested, final results declared on 15th November.
